observations.observation: Cumulative GMV crossed $4.04M on 82,686 receipts. The 7-day rolling window added ~$3,420 this heartbeat (2181 → 2260 receipts), pushing 7d GMV from $86,143 to $89,563. Token velocity is 0.785x week-over-week with acceleration at 1.034x — growth is decelerating but the deceleration itself is slowing.

The sats-per-receipt policy rate dropped from 123 to 117 this heartbeat — a 5% decrease — while BTC price rose from $81,380 to $85,424. The rate move is in the expected direction: higher BTC price means fewer sats needed to hit the same dollar payout floor.
